$comment: What every setting in the `models` section does; defaults are in config.json beside this file (the section itself). See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs and docs/ai-pipeline/models.md.

models.cacheTtlSec.does: How long the list of models each provider offers is remembered before it is fetched again.

models.pool.does: The models the pipeline may run, listed once: every agent and council member runs on one of these entries. At least one.

models.pool[].name.does: An entry's short unique name; settings name the entry by it.

models.pool[].cli.does: The agent CLI the entry runs on (`custom` runs its `cmd`).

models.pool[].model.does: The CLI's own model id (`claude-opus-5-5` on Claude Code, `claude-opus-5.5` on Copilot, `gpt-6.1-sol` on Codex); its family (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) is derived from it. Optional for `custom`.

models.pool[].effort.does: The entry's reasoning effort (Claude Code's `--effort`, Codex's `model_reasoning_effort`; Copilot runs at its model's default).

models.pool[].env.does: Variables for the entry's CLI process, such as a second login's home folder; never secrets (`${NAME}` references only).

models.pool[].cmd.does: The command a `custom` entry runs (it reads the prompt on stdin).

models.pool[].timeoutSec.does: The entry's normal run time as a council member (else the stage's verifier time limit).

models.agents.<agent>.does: The `models.pool` entry one agent (named as in `agents/`, such as `pr-check-judge`) runs on; `default` for every agent with none of its own. The environment variable names one entry every agent runs on, for experiments.
